objective: Falsify WSP82 limitation: create a reusable XOR composition of two paid-data-identified primitive temporal features that does not exist as a single primitive in WSP82's 135-gate basis.

source_private.transition: Each paid action flips its own visible bit. In temporal_xor_new worlds an extra visible bit (action+hidden_offset)%6 flips iff ((len(history)>=2 and history[-1]==history[-2]) XOR (len(history)>=1 and history[-1]==hidden_marker)). Hidden offset in [1..5], marker in [0..5], both SHA256-derived separately from seed and NOT exposed to learners. memoryless_control has only own-bit toggle.
source_private.exact_paid_action_schedule: SHA256('WSP83|DEV|seed|action|step') digest first8 bytes %6, step 0..383; no reset
source_private.physically_unpaid_counterfactual: All 64 public visible states x6 actions x12 fixed past-action histories, evaluator truth only AFTER SHA256 freezing complete model predictions.

models.candidate: Generic, source-blind extension of frozen WSP82 135 Boolean/ReLU public-history feature atoms. Start by attempting single-atom exact fit; if impossible, learn minimum description-length XOR of TWO DISTINCT basis feature predicates per output residual from 384 charged samples (all 135 choose2 considered), program numeric one-hot gate weights plus XOR ReLU composition, cold restore, abstain for ambiguous equal-minimum hypotheses.
models.legacy: Original exact WSP82 135 singleton-feature compiler, unchanged; expected to reject temporal XOR source; do not weaken source or model.
models.symbolic: Independent exactly same-expressivity explicit Boolean feature composer and XOR truth table, fit to same paid history, full query parity required, so any tie is NO numerical intelligence advantage.
models.neural: Original genuinely trained WSP82 25->32 ReLU->6 sigmoid history-aware Adam baseline, 3 independent frozen restarts with <=6000 updates/restart; receives exact 384 paid public rows, no hidden source; >=95% charged training accuracy means CONVERGED, otherwise incomplete negative.
models.other: Original memoryless action flip and exact (state,action,last2history) charged pair memorization with abstain; frozen-before-scoring.
models.capacity_provenance: No new primitive boolean operators beyond a fixed two-atom XOR combiner; 135 features and XOR were selected by researcher before results. No open-ended invention claim.

stop: Exactly one source-paid trajectory per specified unregistered seed, both OS. Preserve any negative outcomes and failure of thresholds. Engineering corrections before first DEV run allowed with exact-source requalification. After first DEV results, do not change source/model/thresholds and call it same experiment.
interpretation: This can establish useful automatically composed numerical features outside the WSP82 singleton bank, but cannot show unrestricted discovery, reasoning, AGI, or superiority to independent same-expressivity symbolic composition. 12 chosen counterfactual contexts are researcher-defined, not naturally sampled trajectories.
